name: ctx
description: The durable half of ctx: a query log (queries) and a zero-useful-result log (misses), one ctx.db per rig at .ctx/ctx.db. The disposable half (index.db, FTS5 over frontmatter) is not a SEA ship — it is rebuilt from markdown on every `ctx index` and has no admin surface.
intended_use: Ivan, reviewing which ctx queries came up empty (the misses table) to decide whether a corpus needs a better terms: field before ever reaching for vectors (plan Phase 4).
